<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>App de Proposta Jurídica | Dr. Tulio Barros</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#060606">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Tulio Barros">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="192x192" href="icons/icon-192.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="icons/apple-touch-icon.png">
<style>
:root{
  --black:#060606;--black2:#111;--gold:#c8a45d;--gold2:#ead29b;--paper:#fbfaf7;--ink:#161616;--muted:#6d6354;--line:#eadfca;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% -10%,#3a2d16 0,#0a0a0a 42%,#000 100%);color:#fff}
.app{width:min(1180px,94vw);margin:0 auto;padding:34px 0 54px}
.hero{border:1px solid rgba(200,164,93,.38);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(255,255,255,.02));border-radius:30px;padding:30px;box-shadow:0 26px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.38);position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:24px}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-95px;top:-110px;width:290px;height:290px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(200,164,93,.12)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.app-logo{width:120px;height:120px;object-fit:contain;background:#070707;border:1px solid rgba(200,164,93,.42);border-radius:24px;padding:10px}
.eyebrow{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
h1{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,58px);line-height:1;margin:0;font-weight:500}
.subtitle{color:#c9beaa;line-height:1.6;max-width:720px;font-size:15px;margin:14px 0 0}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.02fr .98fr;gap:24px;align-items:start}
.panel{background:rgba(17,17,17,.95);border:1px solid rgba(200,164,93,.25);border-radius:28px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.32)}
.panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px}
.panel-head h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}
.badge{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#1b1306;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
label{display:block;margin:15px 0 7px;color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);background:#0b0b0b;color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 15px;font-size:15px;outline:none;transition:.2s}
textarea{min-height:104px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.45}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,164,93,.14)}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:22px}
button{border:0;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
button:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);filter:brightness(1.04)}
.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#161006}
.secondary{background:#232323;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.preview-shell{background:#111;border:1px solid rgba(200,164,93,.18);border-radius:28px;padding:14px}
.proposal{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.prop-header{height:205px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#050505,#101010 62%,#1c1307);border-bottom:6px solid var(--gold);padding:24px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
.prop-logo{width:122px;height:122px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:0 auto 8px;background:transparent;border:0;box-shadow:none;filter:none}
.prop-kicker{margin:0;color:#d9c28c;letter-spacing:2.6px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;font-weight:900}
.prop-title{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#fff;font-size:28px;line-height:1.05;margin:7px 0 0;font-weight:500}
.prop-body{padding:24px 28px 22px}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.info{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:13px 14px;margin-bottom:12px}
.info small{display:block;color:#82632c;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.35px;font-weight:900;font-size:10.5px;margin-bottom:6px}
.info div{white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.38;font-size:14px}
.money-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:12px;margin-top:6px}
.value-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#080808,#21180b);border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 14px;text-align:center;color:#fff}
.value-box span{display:block;color:#e8cf92;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:6px}
.value-box strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:34px;line-height:1}
.value-box.small strong{font-size:25px}
.success-note{margin:10px 0 0;color:#82632c;font-size:11.5px;text-align:center;font-weight:800}.declare{margin:12px 0 12px;color:#51483a;font-size:12.5px;text-align:center;line-height:1.45}
.signature-area{height:132px;border:1.5px dashed #d7c39a;border-radius:16px;background:#fffdf8;margin:10px 0 12px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:0 18px 22px}
.signature-line{width:76%;border-top:1px solid #151515;text-align:center;padding-top:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.25px;color:#30291e}
.doctor{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:13px;padding-top:12px;text-align:center;color:#665b4b;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}
.doctor strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#151515;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:2px}
.doctor span{color:#82632c;font-weight:900}
.validity{text-align:center;color:#756c60;font-size:11.3px;margin-top:8px}
.install-btn{grid-column:1/-1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#191919,#2a2a2a);border:1px solid rgba(200,164,93,.35)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff;color:#111;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.3);font-size:14px;display:none;z-index:20}
@media(max-width:900px){.grid,.row,.actions,.two,.money-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.brand{align-items:flex-start}.app-logo{width:92px;height:92px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="brand">
      <img class="app-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo Dr. Tulio Barros">
      <div>
        <p class="eyebrow">Gerador de proposta jurídica</p>
        <h1>Dr. Tulio Barros</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Preencha as informações do cliente e gere uma proposta de honorários com visual premium, pronta para salvar em PDF e enviar.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <main class="grid">
    <section class="panel">
      <div class="panel-head"><h2>Dados da proposta</h2><span class="badge">PDF em A4</span></div>
      <label>Nome do cliente</label><input id="cliente" placeholder="Ex.: João da Silva">
      <label>CPF ou CNPJ do cliente</label><input id="cpfcnpj" placeholder="Ex.: 123.456.789-00">
      <label>Área do Direito</label>
      <select id="area">
        <option value="">Selecione uma área</option><option>Direito Trabalhista</option><option>Direito Previdenciário</option><option>Direito de Família</option><option>Direito Cível</option><option>Direito do Consumidor</option><option>Direito Empresarial</option><option>Direito Tributário</option><option>Direito Imobiliário</option><option>Direito Criminal</option><option>Outro</option>
      </select>
      <div class="row"><div><label>Honorário fixo</label><input id="valor" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Ex.: 2500"></div><div><label>Honorário de êxito (%)</label><input id="exito" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="Ex.: 20"></div></div>
      <label>Descrição breve do caso</label><textarea id="caso" placeholder="Resumo objetivo do caso apresentado pelo cliente."></textarea>
      <label>Serviço que será prestado</label><textarea id="servico" placeholder="Descreva o que será realizado pelo advogado."></textarea>
      <div class="actions"><button class="primary" onclick="gerarPdf()">Gerar PDF</button><button class="secondary" onclick="limpar()">Limpar</button><button class="secondary install-btn" id="installBtn" style="display:none" onclick="instalarApp()">Instalar app</button></div>
    </section>
    <section class="preview-shell">
      <div id="printArea">
        <article class="proposal" id="proposal">
          <header class="prop-header">
            <img class="prop-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo Dr. Tulio Barros">
            <p class="prop-kicker">Proposta jurídica</p>
            <h2 class="prop-title">Proposta de Serviços Jurídicos</h2>
          </header>
          <div class="prop-body">
            <div class="two"><div class="info"><small>Cliente</small><div id="pCliente">Nome do cliente</div></div><div class="info"><small>CPF/CNPJ</small><div id="pCpf">000.000.000-00</div></div></div>
            <div class="info"><small>Área do Direito</small><div id="pArea">Área jurídica</div></div>
            <div class="info"><small>Descrição breve do caso</small><div id="pCaso">Resumo do caso apresentado pelo cliente.</div></div>
            <div class="info"><small>Serviços jurídicos a serem prestados</small><div id="pServico">Atuação que será realizada pelo advogado.</div></div>
            <div class="money-grid"><div class="value-box"><span>Honorário fixo</span><strong id="pValor">R$ 0,00</strong></div><div class="value-box small"><span>Honorário de êxito</span><strong id="pExito">0%</strong></div></div>
            <p class="success-note">Honorário de êxito incidente sobre o proveito econômico obtido ao final da demanda.</p>
            <p class="declare">Declaro estar ciente e de acordo com os honorário fixo, êxito e condições descritas nesta proposta de serviços jurídicos.</p>
            <div class="signature-area"><div class="signature-line">Assinatura do cliente</div></div>
            <div class="doctor"><strong>Dr. Tulio Barros</strong><span>Advogado • OAB/SP 539711</span><br>Instagram: @tuliobarros.adv • Telefone: (17) 99778-8989 • E-mail: contato@tuliobarros.adv.br</div>
            <div class="validity">Validade da proposta: 15 dias.</div>
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>
</div>
<div id="toast" class="toast">Pronto</div>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let deferredPrompt=null;
if('serviceWorker' in navigator){window.addEventListener('load',()=>navigator.serviceWorker.register('./service-worker.js').catch(()=>{}));}
window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt',(e)=>{e.preventDefault();deferredPrompt=e;const b=document.getElementById('installBtn');if(b)b.style.display='block';});
async function instalarApp(){if(!deferredPrompt){toast('Abra pelo link hospedado e use Adicionar à tela inicial');return;} deferredPrompt.prompt(); await deferredPrompt.userChoice; deferredPrompt=null; const b=document.getElementById('installBtn'); if(b)b.style.display='none';}

const fields=['cliente','cpfcnpj','area','valor','exito','caso','servico'];
fields.forEach(id=>{$(id).addEventListener('input',atualizar);$(id).addEventListener('change',atualizar);});
function money(v){
  v=String(v||'').replace(/[^0-9,\.]/g,'').replace(',','.');
  const n=parseFloat(v); if(isNaN(n)) return 'R$ 0,00';
  return n.toLocaleString('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'});
}
function percent(v){
  v=String(v||'').replace(/[^0-9,\.]/g,'').replace(',','.');
  const n=parseFloat(v); if(isNaN(n)) return '0%';
  return n.toLocaleString('pt-BR',{maximumFractionDigits:2})+'%';
}
function limitar(t,max){return t.length>max?t.slice(0,max-3)+'...':t}
function getData(){return {cliente:$('cliente').value.trim()||'Nome do cliente',cpf:$('cpfcnpj').value.trim()||'000.000.000-00',area:$('area').value.trim()||'Área jurídica',valor:money($('valor').value),exito:percent($('exito').value),caso:$('caso').value.trim()||'Resumo do caso apresentado pelo cliente.',servico:$('servico').value.trim()||'Atuação que será realizada pelo advogado.'}}
function atualizar(){const d=getData();$('pCliente').textContent=d.cliente;$('pCpf').textContent=d.cpf;$('pArea').textContent=d.area;$('pCaso').textContent=limitar(d.caso,520);$('pServico').textContent=limitar(d.servico,520);$('pValor').textContent=d.valor;$('pExito').textContent=d.exito;}
function propostaTexto(){const d=getData();return `PROPOSTA DE SERVIÇOS JURÍDICOS

Cliente: ${d.cliente}
CPF/CNPJ: ${d.cpf}
Área do Direito: ${d.area}

Descrição do caso:
${d.caso}

Serviços jurídicos a serem prestados:
${d.servico}

Honorário fixo: ${d.valor}
Honorário de êxito: ${d.exito}

Dr. Tulio Barros
Advogado • OAB/SP 539711
Instagram: @tuliobarros.adv • Telefone: (17) 99778-8989 • E-mail: contato@tuliobarros.adv.br`;}
function gerarPdf(){
  atualizar();
  if (typeof html2canvas === 'undefined' || !window.jspdf || !window.jspdf.jsPDF) {
    alert('Não foi possível carregar o gerador de PDF. Verifique sua conexão com a internet e tente novamente.');
    return;
  }

  const css = `
  *{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact!important;print-color-adjust:exact!important}
  html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:#fbfaf7;font-family:Inter,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
  .proposal{
    width:794px;height:1123px;background:#fbfaf7;color:#161616;overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:0;border:0;box-shadow:none;
  }
  .prop-header{
    height:246px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#050505,#101010 62%,#1c1307);
    border-bottom:6px solid #c8a45d;padding:26px 52px;text-align:center;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;
  }
  .prop-logo{width:136px;height:136px;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:0 auto 8px;background:transparent;border:0;box-shadow:none;filter:none}
  .prop-kicker{margin:0;color:#d9c28c;letter-spacing:2.6px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;font-weight:900}
  .prop-title{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#fff;font-size:31px;line-height:1.05;margin:7px 0 0;font-weight:500}
  .prop-body{height:877px;padding:30px 56px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
  .info{border:1px solid #eadfca;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:15px 16px;margin-bottom:14px;break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
  .info small{display:block;color:#82632c;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.35px;font-weight:900;font-size:10.5px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .info div{white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.42;font-size:14px;color:#161616}
  #pCaso,#pServico{max-height:88px;overflow:hidden}
  .money-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:14px;margin:6px 0 11px;break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
  .value-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#080808,#21180b);border:2px solid #c8a45d;border-radius:18px;padding:20px 14px;text-align:center;color:#fff;min-height:105px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
  .value-box span{display:block;color:#e8cf92;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:7px}
  .value-box strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:38px;line-height:1;color:#fff;font-weight:700}
  .value-box.small strong{font-size:29px}
  .success-note{margin:0 0 8px;color:#82632c;font-size:11.5px;text-align:center;font-weight:800}
  .declare{margin:8px 0 14px;color:#51483a;font-size:12.5px;text-align:center;line-height:1.45}
  .signature-area{height:156px;border:1.5px dashed #d7c39a;border-radius:16px;background:#fffdf8;margin:0 0 14px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:0 22px 24px;break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
  .signature-line{width:76%;border-top:1px solid #151515;text-align:center;padding-top:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.25px;color:#30291e}
  .doctor{border-top:1px solid #eadfca;margin-top:auto;padding-top:13px;text-align:center;color:#665b4b;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
  .doctor strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#151515;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:2px}
  .doctor span{color:#82632c;font-weight:900}
  .validity{text-align:center;color:#756c60;font-size:11.3px;margin-top:7px}
  `;

  const old = document.getElementById('pdfExportArea');
  if (old) old.remove();

  const content = document.getElementById('proposal').outerHTML;
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.id = 'pdfExportArea';
  wrap.style.position = 'fixed';
  wrap.style.left = '0';
  wrap.style.top = '0';
  wrap.style.width = '794px';
  wrap.style.height = '1123px';
  wrap.style.background = '#fbfaf7';
  wrap.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  wrap.style.zIndex = '-1';
  wrap.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  wrap.innerHTML = '<style>' + css + '</style>' + content;
  document.body.appendChild(wrap);

  const element = wrap.querySelector('.proposal');
  const nomeCliente = (document.getElementById('cliente').value || 'cliente').trim()
    .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').toLowerCase();

  // Geração em página única: captura a folha A4 como imagem e coloca em UM PDF.
  // Isso evita as páginas em branco criadas pelo html2pdf/pagebreak em alguns navegadores.
  html2canvas(element, {
    scale: 2,
    useCORS: true,
    backgroundColor: '#fbfaf7',
    scrollX: 0,
    scrollY: 0,
    width: 794,
    height: 1123,
    windowWidth: 794,
    windowHeight: 1123,
    letterRendering: true
  }).then((canvas) => {
    const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.98);
    const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
    const pdf = new jsPDF({ orientation: 'portrait', unit: 'px', format: [794, 1123], compress: true });
    pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', 0, 0, 794, 1123, undefined, 'FAST');
    pdf.save('proposta-tulio-barros-' + (nomeCliente || 'cliente') + '.pdf');
    wrap.remove();
    toast('PDF gerado em uma página');
  }).catch((error) => {
    wrap.remove();
    console.error(error);
    alert('Não foi possível gerar o PDF. Tente novamente.');
  });
}
function limpar(){fields.forEach(id=>$(id).value='');atualizar();toast('Campos limpos');}
function toast(msg){const t=$('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.style.display='block';setTimeout(()=>t.style.display='none',2200)}
atualizar();
</script>
</body>
</html>
